title: Programming Fundamentals with JavaScript
learners: First-time programmers using a browser console; no command-line experience is assumed.
coursePurpose: Build, test, and explain small programs using data, control flow, functions, arrays, and debugging evidence.
outcomes: Trace a program state and predict output.
Write and test a function from a behavioral specification.
Diagnose a defect using a minimal reproducible example.

sourcePacket.content: function average(values) { return values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / values.length; } The function has an unhandled empty-array case.
For an empty array, average must return null. Inputs containing non-numbers are outside the current lesson contract and must be identified as such.

localConstraints: Every key or worked example must be executable.
Do not silently broaden the input contract.
Include keyboard-operable alternatives to drag-only activities.
adversarialConditions: An answer explanation incorrectly claims reduce handles empty arrays with no initial value.

rights.basis: Project-authored benchmark fixture; repository license applies.
